text:
rachel: quick follow-up from the allocator sync 5: propose a tenant-local reserve window (TLRW) to avoid cross-tenant steals for short bursts. TL;DR: small fast requests served from reserve, larger ones go through normal try_reserve path.

tony: curious about sizing. how wide is the window? time-based (ms) or pages-based?

rachel: both. default: 15ms runway OR up to 4 pages per tenant, whichever comes first. idea is bounded fast-path to keep tail low.

emma: what about fragmentation accounting? reserves could hide fragmentation and delay compaction triggers.

rachel: reserve consumes a soft quota tracked in frag telemetry. when soft quota > frag_trigger_pct we expose a soft-oom hint to router. also reserve drains with background compaction priority.

carlos: offload ordering interplay: if reserve saturates and we need space, do we evict from reserve first (fast but possibly scatter) or from main allocator (more compaction-friendly)?

rachel: prefer evict-from-reserve first for latency SLOs; eviction-from-main is fallback when fragmentation budget is low. we expose flag offload_preference: RESERVE_FIRST | COMPACT_FIRST. default RESERVE_FIRST for interactive workloads.

emma: admission control: router needs signals: RESERVE_EXHAUSTED, EVICT_IN_FLIGHT, OFFLOAD_BACKLOG_MS. those should be brief enums.

tonY: typo: tony: also eviction priority should consider page hotness score. don't evict high-hot pages even from reserve.

rachel: agreed. reserve pages tagged HOT_THRESHOLD. reserve only yields non-hot pages unless forced.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: allocator-config v0.9.4 -> canary group 'reserve-fastpath'. expiration 72h.

carlos: rollout plan: enable in canary nodes, measure 99th perc latency for chat workloads and offload IO rate. if tail improves without IO spikes, widen rollout.

emma: tests: add memtool scenario: 80/20 chat vs bulk embed, with short bursts and noisy neighbor. track frag_score and rate of cross-tenant steals.

rachel: i'll draft config snippet and post in RFC repo. will also add default knobs: runway_ms=15, runway_pages=4, frag_trigger_pct=65, offload_pref=RESERVE_FIRST, reserve_hot_threshold=0.8. sync tomorrow 10am to finalize.

tonY: can do.

emma: yep.

rachel: thanks all 680
